prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Conroe, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1192; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported at an intersection in Conroe, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give the facts of what happened, if that's okay. I'm the driver who was involved in the crash.

Q: That's fine. Can you walk me through what you were doing right before the collision?

A: I was heading through a green light on a main road. Traffic was moderate. I'd slowed a little because the cars ahead of me were bunching up near the crossing.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before impact?

A: Not until the last second. A car came from a side street on my right and didn't stop fully at the sign. It hit the passenger side of my vehicle, and I felt the whole car shift.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was. The belt locked up and I could feel it pull across my chest and shoulder.

Q: Did you seek medical attention afterward?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic later that afternoon. My right shoulder was sore and I had trouble lifting my arm above my head. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with a specialist.

Q: Have you been able to return to normal activities since then?

A: Not fully. Driving for long stretches bothers the shoulder, and I've had to take time off work for physical therapy appointments.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I've been cooperative and I'm willing to provide my medical records. I appreciate the opportunity to explain what happened.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
